definitions.gloss: commemorative ceremony; memorial ceremony; anniversary event
definitions.explanation: A formal ceremony held to mark an anniversary, milestone, or significant event. Common for school anniversaries, company milestones, and national commemorations.

examples.japanese: {創立|そうりつ}50{周年|しゅうねん}{記念|きねん}{式典|しきてん}が{行|おこな}われた。
{記念|きねん}{式典|しきてん}には{多|おお}くの{来賓|らいひん}が{招|まね}かれた。
examples.english: Many distinguished guests were invited to the commemorative ceremony.

examples.japanese: {市|し}の{設立|せつりつ}100{周年|しゅうねん}{記念|きねん}{式典|しきてん}で、{市長|しちょう}がこれまでの{歩|あゆ}みを{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}るスピーチをした。
examples.english: At the city's 100th anniversary ceremony, the mayor gave a speech looking back on its history.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal compound combining {記念|きねん} (commemoration) with {式典|しきてん} (ceremony). Typically features speeches, awards, and formal proceedings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {記念|きねん}{式典|しきてん}を{開催|かいさい}する (to hold a commemorative ceremony)
- {記念|きねん}{式典|しきてん}に{出席|しゅっせき}する (to attend a commemorative ceremony)
- {創立|そうりつ}{記念|きねん}{式典|しきてん} (founding anniversary ceremony)
- {開校|かいこう}{記念|きねん}{式典|しきてん} (school founding ceremony)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {式典|しきてん}: ceremony — the general word for a formal ceremony
- {祝賀会|しゅくがかい}: celebration party — less formal than a ceremony
